title: Music City Secret Great Location
description:
Lots of light & windows in this park like setting Apartment. The location is fantastic only 4 miles to downtown and near the 440 inner loop, I -65 and walk to 12th South area!  You are tucked away so you do not feel as if you are in the heart of Nashville but you are!  You will have green space and trees around you . but also so close to the action!. We are open to a  shorter number of days to stay - just message us and we will check! Please provide first names of all guests staying.
 Thanks!

The space
Should you need a shorter stay- please message us and ask.  The place  all brand new,  you can watch  the large screen smart TV from both the bedroom and futon area ( separated by 5 1/2  foot long closet)   Furnished Kitchen area.  Dining table and chairs right by great window.   The television is mounted on the wall with a maneuverable mount so you can adjust it to your preferred location to view  .  We live in a separate house on the property - your place is very quiet.  We also have Wi-Fi for you.

Guest access
The Apartment - Bedroom, Bath, Full size very comfortable Futon , Kitchen and dining space -  is completely private.  The laundry is close by and potentially shared on occasion.  We have a window air conditioner , one person thought is was a bit noisy, but she had it on Max and 62 degrees so at other settings its very quite. All our other guests have not mentioned it and given us great reviews.

The apartment - Bedroom, Bath, Full size very comfortable Futon, Kitchen and Dining - is completely private.  The laundry - a short walk out their front door and to the left is potentially shared by a full time tenant all upstairs..  There is a patio area as well  which is just a short walk away and it is used by the owners only who would give them as much privacy as they want

Other things to note
Should you need a one or two day stay - you can message us and we will see if we can work it out. 
No smoking in apartment or on property.
The Wi-Fi can be affected by weather and also the many trees in our area.
